subject: how to interpret contents of genind@tab slot

messages.author: e251dfe1bb017bb7
messages.subject: how to interpret contents of genind@tab slot
parts:
Hello all and particularly Dr. Kamvar
I'm sorry, but I do not fully understand the meaning of the information in the poppr manual section " Getting to know adegenet"s genind object".  If someone could just tell me what the 2 snp alleles are  (ie, A,C,G,T) in each of the following adegenet @tab slots I might be able to understand the documentation better. Again, I apologize for my lack of understanding.
Example 1:
gi.ggcr@tab[1:1,11:12]
         dDocent_Contig_28_308.G dDocent_Contig_28_308.A
GGCR_001                       1                       1

Does this mean the snp alleles are G A?
...............................................................................................
Example 2:
gi.ggcr@tab[1:1,13:14]
         dDocent_Contig_31_10.G dDocent_Contig_31_10.T
GGCR_001                      2                      0

Does this mean the snp alleles are GG?

Thank you very much for the explanations

Janice Boyd

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] how to interpret contents of genind@tab slot
parts:
Yes, your interpretation is correct. Each column of the genind object will be named as <LOCUS>.<ALLELE> and the values will be the counts of each allele.

The first example shows the genotype "G/A" at the "dDocent_Contig_28_308" locus and the second example shows the genotype "G/G" at the "dDocent_Contig_31_10" locus.

I apologize that the documentation did not provide enough clarity. I will try to improve it for the next release.

Best,

Zhian
